title: feat(metadata-protocol): a save re-pointing a stored record-mode amount's currencyField answers 409 currency_field_repointed
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbQi4324kvTvhESFxb8nooSV)_

Fixes #31949

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — a save that answered 200 now answers 409 without `force`
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill teaches `currency_mode_to_record` or re-pointing `currencyField`; `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` teaches only the backfill after a switch into record mode, which stays true

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 已存数据的 record 模式金额字段,把 `currencyField` 改指到另一个字段(同级字段或 `MASTER_DETAIL.CODE` 路径,四个方向)时,元数据保存答 409 `destructive_change`,发现码 `currency_field_repointed`,`force` 可放行。
- **为什么改:** 金额是裸数字,币种看指针;改指针不换算任何已存金额,整表静默换币种,原来 200 静默通过。这是 `currency_mode_to_record` 的同族缺口。
- **风险与回滚:** 只读元数据、不读任何数据行,只在已有旧版本时触发(启动注册不拦)。回滚即 revert 本 PR;误报代价是一次 `force`。
- **先看:** `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-write-face.ts` 新增的 `currency_field_repointed` 分支和消息里点名的补救命令;其次 `content/docs/data-modeling/currency.mdx` 新小节。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --project local src/protocol-destructive-currency-mode.test.ts`,预期 18 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位做契约复审后落地。

## What changes

- **The finding.** `detectDestructiveObjectChanges` raises `currency_field_repointed` on the amount field when a stored `record`-mode amount's `currencyField` changes to another non-empty pointer. It covers every form the spec admits since PR #31956: sibling to sibling, sibling to `MASTER_DETAIL.CODE` path, path to sibling, path to path. It rides the existing Phase 3a-destructive gate, so the save answers the existing 409 `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE`, `force` lifts it, it reads no row, and it fires only where a previous version exists.
- **Readings.** Pointers compare as written, the way `recordCurrencyFieldOf` reads them. An identical pointer raises nothing; one that differs only in white space names another field and raises the finding. It is judged by the stored side (`isStored(prevField)`), and a field that was a formula has no record pointer, so it raises nothing. A switch into record mode raises only `currency_mode_to_record`, never both.
- **The message names only remedies that exist (ADR-0144 D5, measured at origin/main 3224545455).** For a sibling target it names the code backfill for rows whose new code is blank (`os migrate record-currency-codes` and its REST door `POST /api/v1/meta/_migrate-record-currency-codes`). For a path target it names none, because the child stores no code and follows its parent. When the amount declared `homeAmount`, it says the stored home amounts and rates were converted from the old code and the save does not re-rate them. It then names `os migrate recompute-home-amounts --object OBJECT --field FIELD`, which is a shell command with no REST door. If the save also drops `homeAmount`, it says nothing re-rates them.
- **One shared remedy text.** The backfill clause is now `recordCurrencyCodeBackfillRemedy`, used by both findings. The `currency_mode_to_record` message is byte-identical, and its existing pins pass unchanged.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/data-modeling/currency.mdx` gains a "Re-pointing `currencyField`" subsection beside the switch subsection.
- **Changeset.** `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` patch, with `Metadata-protocol: none` (see Acceptance notes).

## Tests

- A new top-level `describe` in the existing harness `packages/objectql/src/protocol-destructive-currency-mode.test.ts` adds 11 cases. They cover the four re-point directions (409 envelope `code` + `status` + finding, the backfill named or withheld, no row read), the home-amount clause both ways, `force`, identical pointers (sibling and path), a first save with no previous version, a former formula, and the mode-switch exclusivity. The file runs 18/18.
- **Ablation.** I committed the fix first. Then `ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `&& prevPointer !== nextPointer` with `&& prevPointer === 'ABLATION_REPOINT'` (anchor x1 to x0), and I rebuilt `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`. The dist preflight found the marker in 2 built files. The harness went **6 failed / 12 passed**: the four direction cases and the two home-amount cases. On restore, the blob matched HEAD and `git diff HEAD` was empty. After a rebuild, the `--absent` preflight found the marker in none of 24 files, and the harness ran 18/18. A first attempt kept the anchor inside its replacement, so the tool refused it as a no-op. A second attempt with `&& false` failed the dts build. Neither counts as a reading.

## Acceptance notes

- **`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `patch` (claim amend 1).** The 409 is a narrowing of what a save accepts without `force`, so the line carries the `(narrowing)` arm, and the changeset carries the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`: no key, value, schema, export or type moves, and there is nothing for a migration to rewrite. The metadata an author can write is unchanged, and a save with `force` is accepted as before, so the kind stays `none`. The precedent `currency_mode_to_record` (a3d24c9) shipped as a new finding in the same face with `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **Path pointers in objectql.** On main today the engine still reads a path pointer as a sibling column name (the objectql half is #31911). So `os migrate recompute-home-amounts` lists a path-following child's rows as `code_blank` until #31911 lands. The message still names it, because it is the one recompute that exists.
- **ADR-0144.** I made no edit (Tier H). The seat can decide whether D5's recompute note owes a line about re-pointing.
